title: Customer Reference Library
summary: This note details the creation of a centralized reference folder to address repeated technical questions about elevator codes and design requirements. The folder included common questions, code sections, and pre-approved sample responses, which served as a single source of truth for the team. This initiative resulted in more accurate and consistent communication, reduced response times, and improved customer satisfaction.

key_points.text: Included exact code or compliance sections supporting answers
Included pre-approved sample responses PMs could copy/paste
Became a single source of truth for the team
Significantly reduced time spent responding to customers
Improved customer satisfaction by shortening response times and reducing escalations
